description: Copyscape is a free plagiarism checker. The software lets you detect duplicate content and check if your text is original. Plagiarism Detection: Scans the web to detect duplicate content. Premium Services: Offers advanced features like batch search and private index. API Integration: Allows integration with other platforms for automated checks. User-Friendly Interface: Simple process to check content originality.
